nodes.natural_language: We write $\lfloor X \rfloor$ to mean the greatest integer less than or equal to $X$; for example $\lfloor 3\frac{1}{2} \rfloor = 3$. If $N = \frac{1}{3}$, what is the value of $\lfloor 10N \rfloor + \lfloor 100N \rfloor + \lfloor 1000N \rfloor + \lfloor 10,000N \rfloor$? Show that it is 3702.
